blocks.html: When a doctor explains a health camp to villagers, a company shows its sales to investors or you present a science project, pictures and short points work better than long paragraphs. Presentation software helps you build a sequence of slides that combine text, pictures, charts, sound and video.
Definition: A presentation is a collection of slides shown one after another to explain an idea to an audience. Presentation software is used to create, edit and show such slides.
Examples: Microsoft PowerPoint (.pptx), LibreOffice Impress (.odp), Google Slides (online), Apple Keynote, Canva.
Uses: classroom teaching, school projects, seminars, business meetings, product launches, training, digital notice boards and photo albums.
Start PowerPoint from the Start menu and choose Blank Presentation, or pick a ready- made template.

blocks.html: A layout decides where the placeholders go. Common layouts: Title Slide, Title and Content, Section Header, Two Content, Comparison, Title Only, Blank, Picture with Caption. Change it from Home → Layout.

items.html: Themes (Design tab) apply matching colours, fonts and backgrounds to all slides at once; Variants offer colour options.
Format Background sets a solid colour, gradient, picture or texture.
Slide Size: Widescreen 16:9 (default, suits modern screens) or Standard 4:3.
Designer / Design Ideas (in newer versions) suggests layouts for your pictures automatically.

blocks.html: View → Slide Master controls the look of every slide. Put the school logo, a footer or a font change on the master, and it appears on every slide that uses it — you do not have to change 30 slides one by one.

items.html: Effect Options: direction, e.g. Push from Left.
Duration: speed in seconds.
Sound: optional (use rarely).
Advance Slide: On Mouse Click or After a set time (for self-running shows).
Apply To All: same transition for every slide.

rows: How an object appears (Fly In, Fade)
Draws attention to an object already on the slide (Pulse, Grow/Shrink)
How an object leaves (Fade Out, Fly Out)
Moves the object along a line or curve

blocks.html: Timing: Start On Click / With Previous / After Previous, plus Duration and Delay. The Animation Pane lists all animations in order; drag to change the order. Animation Painter copies an animation to other objects.

rows: Editing slides one at a time
Typing and organising text of all slides
All slides as thumbnails; rearrange, hide, apply transitions
On a second screen: notes, next slide and a timer for the speaker
Pen to draw on the slide

blocks.html: Rehearse Timings (Slide Show tab) records how long you spend on each slide so the show can run by itself. Record Slide Show also records your voice.

rows: Opens directly as a slide show
Read-only copy for sharing or printing
Video of the presentation with timings and narration

blocks.html: Printing (Ctrl + P): print Full Page Slides, Notes Pages, Outline or Handouts (e.g. 3 slides per page with lines for the audience to write notes).

items.html: 6 × 6 rule: no more than six bullet points per slide and about six words per point.
One main idea per slide; use a picture or chart instead of a paragraph.
Large fonts (at least 24 pt for text, 36 pt for titles); dark text on a light background or the reverse.
Keep the same theme and font throughout.
Use transitions and animations to support the message, not to show off.
Practise with a timer; speak to the audience, not to the screen.
End with a summary slide and a Thank you / Questions? slide.

lessons.title: Workshop 4: "Digital India in My Village" presentation

blocks.html: Aim: To create, animate and deliver an 8-slide presentation.

items.html: Create a new presentation with a widescreen theme. Save it as DigitalIndia.pptx .
Slide 1 (Title Slide): title, your name, class and school.
Slide 2: "What is Digital India?" — four short bullet points.
Slide 3: a SmartArt process of how a UPI payment is made in four steps.
Slide 4: a table of five government apps and their uses.
Slide 5: a column chart of the number of people in your family using UPI, internet banking and online classes.
Slide 6: pictures with captions of services in your area (e.g. a Common Service Centre).
Slide 7: "Stay safe online" — five tips, each appearing with a Fly In animation After Previous.
Slide 8: "Thank you" with a hyperlink to the Digital India website.

items.html: Presentation software creates slides with text, pictures, charts, audio and video. PowerPoint, Impress and Google Slides are examples.
The PowerPoint window has a ribbon, thumbnails pane, slide pane with placeholders, notes pane and status bar.
Layouts place placeholders; themes and the Slide Master give all slides a consistent look.
The Insert tab adds pictures, tables, charts, SmartArt, media and hyperlinks.
Transitions work between slides; animations work on objects (entrance, emphasis, exit, motion paths).
Views: Normal, Outline, Slide Sorter, Notes Page, Reading and Slide Show; F5 starts the show and Esc ends it.
Presentations can be saved as .pptx, .ppsx, .potx, .pdf or .mp4 and printed as handouts.
